items.stem: A user loses the device holding their self-custody wallet but still has the seed phrase. What is true?

options.text: They can restore the same accounts on a new device from the seed phrase
options.rationale: Correct: the seed phrase deterministically regenerates the keys.

options.text: The funds are permanently lost with the device
They must contact the blockchain's support desk
options.rationale: There is no central support desk for self-custody.

options.text: The addresses will be different and funds unreachable
options.rationale: HD derivation reproduces the same addresses.

items.explanation: Correct: the seed phrase deterministically regenerates the keys.

items.stem: Which TWO practices meaningfully reduce the risk of a drained wallet? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Reviewing exactly what a transaction or approval authorises before signing
options.rationale: Correct: understanding the request prevents malicious approvals.

options.text: Keeping large balances in a hardware or multisig wallet rather than a hot wallet
options.rationale: Correct: cold and multisig storage reduce exposure.

options.text: Sharing the seed phrase with a support agent to verify ownership
options.rationale: No legitimate agent needs your seed phrase.

options.text: Posting the public key screenshot in a forum for help
options.rationale: This invites targeted phishing and reveals nothing useful for support.

items.explanation: Correct: understanding the request prevents malicious approvals.

items.stem: Why is blind signing an opaque transaction dangerous?

options.text: You may authorise an action, such as an unlimited approval, that you did not intend
options.rationale: Correct: without readable details you cannot judge what you approve.

options.text: Blind signing always fails and wastes gas
options.rationale: It often succeeds, which is the danger.

options.text: Blind signing reveals your seed phrase
options.rationale: Signing does not reveal the seed.

options.text: Blind signing is required by all wallets
options.rationale: Readable signing is preferred and available.

items.explanation: Correct: without readable details you cannot judge what you approve.
